# 054 Launch transient-shaper qualification, realtime audit, and benchmark

## Outcome

Qualify the accepted launch dual-envelope transient shaper without changing its product contract.

## Context

Issue 020 owns the complete descriptor/scalar/W4/W8/registry/graph product. This stateless issue
starts only after that exact product passes, never inspects V1, and has exactly **two total
attempts**: Terra attempt 1 and one bounded Sol correction/review. A second failure stops.
`timed_benchmark_invocations=0`; no timed benchmark is authorized before every nonbenchmark gate
and workload-free preflight passes and root explicitly authorizes the one invocation.

## Scope

- Add a checked independent envelope/contrast/output corpus across all launch rates, parameter
  boundaries/interiors, all links, representative automation partitions and impulse/step/decaying
  inputs.
- Execute exactly 10,000 seeded legal/malformed transitions and frozen million-sample finite rows,
  plus expanded homogeneous-cohort, scalar-tail and deterministic graph matrices.
- Run the exact 100,000-render realtime audit over a real bank-plus-tail graph with zero forbidden
  operations while armed and destruction off render.
- Prove native scalar/AVX2, AArch64 NEON and Wasm scalar/base-simd128 build/selection/instruction
  contracts, including zero transient gain/mix FMA contractions.
- Preflight the descriptive benchmark without launching its workload; only after authorization run
  exactly one invocation containing one warmup and two measured rounds, with no threshold/tuning/
  retry. Produce checksummed audition PCM and a blinded level-matched listening handoff.

## Required public interfaces/contracts

Consume the exact accepted Issue-020 descriptor, coefficient table, state/resource payload,
scalar/bank operation graph and registry/graph artifact. Qualification outputs are deterministic,
checksummed and separate from production DSP.

## Deliverables

Independent corpus/manifests, expanded deterministic rows, realtime-audit record, target and
instruction evidence, zero-launch benchmark preflight and sole authorized raw descriptive result,
plus audition/preregistration and completed listening records when humans actually perform them.

## Explicit non-goals

Production DSP repair, new detector/mode/quality/lookahead/sidechain, changed coefficient/domain/
tolerance/state, a reusable dynamics framework, optimization to improve a descriptive number, or
blocking unrelated effects/deployment. A product defect requires a new bounded product issue.

## Dependencies by exact issue title

- Launch dual-envelope transient shaper

## Hazards/decisions

The benchmark is descriptive. Faster and slower results both pass when correctness and schema
gates pass. Listening complements objective evidence and cannot repair it. Additional detector
ideas may be recorded as research only and cannot alter the launch candidate.

## Acceptance gates with objective measurements

1. Corpus paths/hashes and an independent `f64` oracle are checked and reject corruption; all
   rate/amount/mix/link/partition rows meet Issue 020's frozen tolerances.
2. Exactly 10,000 seeded transitions and the frozen million-sample rows are repeatable, finite and
   report no recovery for valid inputs; malformed cases recover/reject only as specified.
3. Expanded bank/tail/cohort and graph runs match scalar state/output/reports and canonical artifacts.
4. Exactly 100,000 q128 renders of the real product graph report zero allocations/frees, locks,
   logging, I/O, syscalls or feature detection while armed; teardown occurs after disarm.
5. Native, AArch64 and Wasm build/selection and named instruction scans pass without relaxed SIMD,
   hidden FMA contraction, architecture-wide flags or compiled track limits.
6. Benchmark preflight proves argument/schema/output/overwrite/shell behavior with zero workload
   launches. After all nonbenchmark gates and root authorization, exactly one invocation performs
   one warmup and two measured rounds, persists raw output and is never tuned or retried.
7. Checksummed audition PCM and preregistration identify the sealed candidate; completed human
   records are reported without synthetic listeners. Final workspace/policy gates pass.

## Target matrix

Pinned native scalar and runtime-gated AVX2/AVX2+FMA; AArch64 NEON W4; wasm32 scalar and base
`simd128` W4. Compile/instruction evidence is not a device/browser runtime claim.

## Required evidence

Candidate and corpus hashes; oracle maxima; exact seeded/long-row/cohort/audit counts; target and
instruction reports; benchmark preflight launch count and, only after authorization, raw two-round
records/environment/hash; listening artifacts; attempt count; benchmark invocation count; and
strict Terra/final Sol verdicts.
